items.title: Introduction to Modern AI. Learn to use AI in your daily life, craft effective chatbot prompts, and use computer vision and machine translation.
Prompt Like an Engineer. Apply an engineering mindset to AI. Design, iterate & verify prompts, work with local & cloud LLMs, and evaluate outputs.
Build your Resume with AI. Use AI to enhance your resume, customize it for jobs, and protect your privacy while staying true to your real experiences.

Find Insights with AI. Learn to transform raw customer feedback into actionable insights through AI-powered thematic analysis. You'll also learn to strategically select AI tools, ensure output reliability, and integrate human oversight for confident decision-making.
